item.title: Test Blog Post
item.description:
Test Blog Post

This is a test blog post created via the Windows deployment script.

Testing the cross-platform workflow:

  • Written on Windows
  • Synced to Hugo content
  • Built and deployed to GitHub Pages

Steps tested

  1. git pull to sync
  2. Copy from vault BLOG/ to content/posts/
  3. Hugo build
  4. Push to master
  5. GitHub Actions deploys to gh-pages

All good!
